description.narrative:
Live and Learn Cambodia (LLC) is a local organization envisaged for a sustainable and equitable Cambodia free from poverty. To realise its vision, LLC aims to empower Cambodians with innovative solutions to achieve a sustainable livelihood and environment. LLC’s strategies are to strengthen resilience of communities through promotion of nature-based solutions and community-based actions, equip and empower communities with sufficient capacity, tools, infrastructure, and finance, and enhance communities toattain sustainableand equitable access to appropriate livelihoods (i.e. food, water, sanitation and hygiene, economics and employment opportunity andsocial welfare).
Through several years of extensive experience in the implementation of renewable energy projects, particularly solar, biogas and wind energy, LLC has contributed to improving livelihoods of indigenous communities through lighting, water supply, agriculture, and energy for cooking. LLC has provided local support on development and operation of renewable energy system to enhance the quality, accessibility, and reliability of RE technologies.
Oxfam in Cambodia with support from DFAT and SDC funded Inclusion Project, is partnered with LLC to implement “Community Power Hub Project” with two strategic objectives:
1) 9 CORE groups to havemore knowledge and awareness on RETs (Renewable Energy Technologies, solar photovoltaics) and are capable of basic maintenance of their RET system. 2) Challenges of 9 CORE groups and issues of their systems and proposed solutions are documented.
The expected outcomes of the project are:
1) Representatives of 9 CORE groups in Ratanak Kiri province have increased their knowledge by 50% on RETs, particularly on solar photovoltaics system for water pumping (5 groups) and rural electrification (4 groups). 2) Local RET technicians of 9 CORE groups are able to provide their services on routine basis operating their RET system. 3) Capacity development and technical operation plans, incl. adopted business model of the 9 CORE groups are developed. 4) Proposed technical solutions for rehabilitation of the 9 CORE systems are identified and documented.

participating-org.narrative:
LLC was established in 2004, registered at the Ministry of Interior in 2005, and updated registration in 2018. LLC tackles development challenges by empowering communities to improve resilience through the adoption of innovative solutions and advocates for sustainable and appropriate solutions to address local community needs and priorities. LLC is specializing in community organization, empowerment, capacity building, stakeholder engagement, education and awareness raising, and pro-poor innovations. Vision: LLC is envisioned to achieve a sustainable and equitable Cambodia free from poverty Mission: to empower Cambodians with innovative solutions to achieve a sustainable livelihood and environment. Goal: builds resilience of local communities by developing their human, social, environmental and financial capital through innovation, multi-stakeholder platforms and partnerships. Values: Good Governance – accountability, transparency, equitability, participation, legality, effectiveness and efficiency are integral in all our decision-making and implementation Innovation – we value the constant striving to apply fresh thinking, and implement better solutions, to create value for our Communities Partnership – we actively seek out Partners with whom we can work with, to advance common goals, and share mutual benefits Expertise – we highly value the specific skills and knowledge of all our staff, partners and communities; and activelyseek to develop knowledge creation and operationalization, education,and capacity building opportunities
LLC program strategy fitswith the local contexts (needs and priorities of local communities and the government) and national/international strategies and commitments. It has a good mix of staff expertise with good flexibility in terms of project implementation, stakeholder engagement andthe introduction of new innovation. LLC has strong expertise in the areas of workshop delivery and has access to regional and localnetworks to include the right people, the development and implementation of case studies, and video production.
